create_renderer: create a renderer instance using the create_renderer factory with cpp vispy python or htt type
add_object: add a 3D mesh object model to the renderer by its ID and file path
remove_object: remove a previously added 3D object model from the renderer by its ID
render_object: render a 3D object in a specified pose with camera intrinsics to produce RGB and depth images
set_light_cam_pos: set the 3D position of the point light source in camera coordinates
